name: self
argv:
Review the implementation of story S1 of calc-cli in this read-only checkout against docs/requirements.md and these clauses:
- [INTRODUCE] R-CLI (docs/requirements.md §1), clause 1.1: exits with the sum of the integers A and B
- [INTRODUCE] R-CLI (docs/requirements.md §1), clause 1.2: exit 2 on a usage error (any other number of arguments)
Do not modify any file. Answer with ONLY one JSON object: {"findings": [{"id": "short-id", "blocking": true or false, "severity": "low|medium|high|critical", "summary": "one line", "reproducer": null or {"clause": "<requirement id>/<clause> as listed above, e.g. R-9/3", "subject": {"kind": "cli_invocation|python_callable|file_artifact|process_effect", "locator": "..."}, "stimulus": {...}, "observable": {..., "within_s": 10}}}]}
A finding is acted on only when its reproducer — the behaviour the cited clause demands, in the probe's grammar — is observed NOT to hold when the kernel runs it, and the clause's approved criteria expect exactly that behaviour; any other finding is recorded for a person to triage.
